why_ai: Unlicensed SaaS, but embedded trade workflows and payments make AI-native substitution slower than horizontal tools.
why_clarity: First-time fix rate is measurable, yet dispatch matching still runs on a dispatcher's mental model.
why_digital: Software built and delivered online, sold to trade contractors largely by remote demo.

why_ai: Large enterprise contracts and implementation relationships slow substitution, though predictive maintenance automates.
why_clarity: Uptime and visit counts are measurable, but OEM and third-party problems differ in method.
why_digital: Contract, entitlement and telemetry data in, software out, sold through enterprise sales.

why_ai: Nameplate photos and part scans can build the record automatically with commodity vision models.
why_clarity: Record completeness per visit is an exact, repeated, checkable measure.
why_digital: Starts from physical equipment photographed on site, ending as a software record.

why_ai: Shop scheduling and repair estimates are structured problems, though dealer networks slow vendor substitution.
why_clarity: Downtime is measurable, but repair estimates still rest on service managers' experience.
why_digital: Shop and warranty data in, software out, sold through dealer and DMS relationships.

why_ai: Visit records assembled from photos, scans and speech use commodity AI capabilities.
why_clarity: Every visit needs the same record, and time-to-moving is directly measurable.
why_digital: Captures physical visits on a device, delivering a digital record to the owner.

why_ai: Pricing signal sits in contractors' won-and-lost job history, which models can learn directly.
why_clarity: Task prices recur by trade and region, with win rates as a slow but objective check.
why_digital: Job history and cost data in, price books delivered as software content.

why_ai: Verification and inspection scoring are structurable, though client trust in proof keeps contracts sticky.
why_clarity: Recurring site visits against promised standards, but quality judgement is partly subjective.
why_digital: Starts from unsupervised physical sites, verified into digital records.

why_ai: Proprietary installed-base telemetry protects the OEM, though converting it to dispatch is automatable.
why_clarity: Fault caught before the customer notices is checkable, and telemetry gives fast feedback.
why_digital: Machine telemetry and engineering data in, dispatched actions out via software.

why_ai: Diagnosis prediction and technician matching are supervised problems on data vendors already hold.
why_clarity: Thousands of near-identical service calls with first-time fix rate as the objective check.
why_digital: Job and customer data in, dispatch software out, sold to contractors online.

why_ai: Routing and trip batching are classic optimisation problems software solves directly.
why_clarity: Revenue per drive hour is an exact metric, and routing methods are well codified.
why_digital: Route and job data in, software out, but rural owners buy through local relationships.

why_ai: Part identification and cross-referencing are matching problems, though certifying provenance carries accountability.
why_clarity: Verified parts are checkable, but sourcing still relies on phone networks and judgement.
why_digital: Physical parts and documentation sourced partly by phone, tracked in software.
